fieldValues.comment_text: Dissent (agent reviewer, 2026-11-09, recorded by hand per remedy 2829dcf3): part of the evidence for the server-sent events transport is weaker than this remedy's sources state. The reviewer of the spike (srs-web#773, closed) found that "typing survives 311/311" with server-sent events is true by construction: the test's stand-in panel appended cues to the page and never touched the record form, so it shows the stream does not touch the document, not that the real panel keeps a minute being typed. The "about 1 ms" figure was measured in the handler, not to the screen. Chrome's local network access block was tested only headless against a fake origin with a simulated grant; headed Chrome and Brave are untested. The (b) result, MCP writes wiping a typed minute, had no control run. The reviewer held that none of this changes the choice of transport. Open until srs-web#768 measures typing and delay in the real panel. Sources: semanticops.com#59, srs-web#773 review comment, srs-web#772.
